name: ad-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Andorra for tax year 2026, read from Llei 20/2007 on SA and SL companies, Llei 10/2012 on foreign investment, the corporate tax law and the social security law, as consolidated on the Portal Jurídic d'Andorra. Covers the SL (and single-member SLU) and the SA, minimum capital of EUR 3,000 and EUR 60,000 paid in full, name reservation, the notarial deed and registration, the 15-day registry and 2-month foreign-investment decision periods, prior authorisation
author: openaccountants
